title: agent.tool.span v1
description: One tool call of a coding agent with its wall time, derived after the fact from the agent's transcript by adapters/spans (tool_use paired with its tool_result). Answers where agent time goes. Carries the command class and, for waits, what is waited on; never command text, arguments or output. span_id is a hash of the transcript file and tool call id, so a rescan produces the same id.

agent_id.description: Subagent or workflow lane id; empty for a main session

workflow_id.description: Workflow run id when the call ran in a workflow lane

label.description: Lane label or description from the transcript metadata

project.description: Project resolved from the call's cwd; 'unknown' when it cannot be told

class.description: What kind of work the call was. wait means the call polled, slept or blocked on something else.

wait_target.description: Only for class wait: what the call waited on. time is a bare sleep with nothing else to name.

duration_ms.description: Result time minus call time; absent when the result never landed

status.description: error: the tool reported failure. lost: the transcript has no result for the call.

exit_code.description: Shell exit code when the transcript reports one
